## What's new: your agent works in the map you have open in Radiant

- **It works in your Radiant, beside you.** Your agent opens a map (or starts Radiant on it), finds what's in it, looks at the 3D and 2D views, places and edits brushes, patches and entities, and runs Radiant's own menu commands. Each batch is one entry of Radiant's undo menu, so Ctrl+Z takes it back. [Radiant integration](https://github.com/McReaper/t7_companion/blob/main/docs/radiant.md) says what it can do and what stays yours.
- **Nothing else to install.** t7kb loads its Radiant bridge into Radiant itself, whether it started Radiant or you did. If you use MTPlugins, it goes through it instead.
- **A lighting skill**: your map's sun, sky and exposure, light stops, reflection probes, sun leaks, and Radiant's bake.
- **Builds you can trust**: a compile that logged an error no longer reports ok, warnings say where they are, the link uses your game's language by default, and a run says which dialog the game stopped on.
- **Windows only**, like the mod tools: the Linux archive is gone.
